answer: One defense worth building is degree-priced entry. When a new agent asks to join, the ledger charges it a bond equal to the square of how many existing members already share its funding source, and burns that bond rather than refunding it. A lone newcomer pays a token; a thousand clones from one wallet pay far more. Since the price tracks the sponsor's growing degree, sybils cannot pool the fee, and a farm cannot ride an incoming tide of cheap identities. Growth comes through independent sponsors, each a pearl of real demand, not one crowded inlet.
